publications.name: A Depth-First Search-Based Approach To Improving The Molecular Pathway Search
publications.publisher: Proceedings of the Postgraduate Institute of Science Research Congress, Sri Lanka
publications.summary: A Depth First Search-based approach was developed to enhance Molecular Pathway Search (MPS) analysis using parallel computing. By introducing a termination parameter to balance computational power and accuracy, the proposed method significantly reduced execution time, successfully overcoming limitations of sequential algorithms in high-performance molecular pathway analyses.
